Counsel for Applicant :- Rohit Kumar Mishra,Ajay Kumar Kashyap,Brajesh Kumar Singh,Mahen Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
610 of 2022 S.T. No. 804 of 2022 at Police Station- Baradari, District- Bareilly under Sections 452,
376(2) N, 343, 323, 504, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 06.08.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 21.11.2022.

The following arguments made by Shri Mahendra Kumar Maurya, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agarwal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Raj Prajapati Alias Virendra vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81448778/

sentences.text: 1. The delay in lodgment of the FIR is fatal to the prosecution case in the facts and circumstances of this case.
2. The FIR is a result of a relationship going awry.
3. The victim and the applicant were intimate and were in a live in relationship.
4. The victim was estranged from her husband and was residing separately.
5. The applicant never gave a plighted word to marry the victim.
6. The criminal case is being leveraged to force the applicant to marry the victim and to extort money from him 7.
The applicant did not capture or circulate any indecent video or photos of the victim.
8. No videos or photos have been recovered or traced from the applicant.
9. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
10. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
11. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Raj Prajapati Alias Virendra be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Pravin  Raj Prajapati Alias Virendra vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81448778/
